title: baseline is 0 when the bot chat history is not loaded at start time
trigger: Press the switch-PM button for a bot whose chat was never opened; the start goes out before history loads
effect: When history loads, an old bot message with a switch-inline button has id > 0 and sends the user back to the origin chat immediately
fix: Take the baseline from the sent start message id (the send ack), not the loaded history

title: Chat-row menu becomes invisible but stays open when its chat is removed (also the top-person menu)
trigger: Right-click a chat row (or a top-people tile); the chat is deleted/left from another device while the menu is open.
effect: chat_menu_overlay and top_person_menu_overlay return an empty div without the dismiss layer, but chat_list.menu stays Some: arrows are swallowed (context_menu_key), the sidebar stays peeked, Escape needed.
fix: Drop chat_list.menu when the chat leaves the session (same sync that closes other chat-bound boxes).

title: Secret-chat inline-bot warning stash is not bound to the chat that asked
trigger: In secret chat A press a switch-inline button (stash set, banner shown), open secret chat B without confirming, press Confirm on the banner.
effect: pending_inline_bot_alert survives the chat change (never cleared on sync_chat_ui) and the banner/confirm check only that the open chat is secret, so A's query text is inserted into B's composer.
fix: Store the stash with its chat: `pending_inline_bot_alert: Option<(ChatId, String)>` and drop it in replace_chat_ui / compare on confirm.

title: Message menu becomes invisible but stays open when its message is removed
trigger: Right-click a message; the sender deletes it (or the history window drops it) while the menu is open.
effect: The overlay returns an empty div (no DismissLayer), but message_ui.menu stays Some: context_menu_open() is true, arrow keys are swallowed by context_menu_key, the sidebar peek is held, until Escape is pressed.
fix: Close the menu when its message goes (check in the frame sync) or build the menu stage from a snapshot so it never depends on the live message; draw/dismiss from the same value that says open.

title: Pinned-bar Hide / Unpin all confirm closures run outside the window scope of the bar
trigger: In a chat window click Hide on the pinned bar (or open the pinned list and Unpin all / hide) and confirm in the kit alert.
effect: confirm() calls app.update without in_window_scope, so `this.history.hidden_pinned` / `pinned_list_open` are written to the main window's HistoryUi instead of the chat window's slot: the chat window's bar does not hide and its list stays open; the note also lands in the main window.
fix: Capture `self.windows.scope` when opening the alert and run the closure through in_window_scope / spawn_scoped (Asker).

title: Pinned list panel flag is not reset when the chat changes, and a lone pin has no toggle to close it
trigger: Open the pinned list in chat A (several pins), open chat B that has exactly one pin.
effect: pinned_list_open is a HistoryUi bool never reset on chat change (grep: only set in the bar/list handlers), so chat B shows its list open; with count==1 the bar shows the unpin/hide X instead of the list toggle, so the list can only be closed by clicking a row or unpinning.
fix: Move it to ChatUi (replaced per chat) or key it by AccountChat: `pinned_list_open: Option<AccountChat>`.

title: A late report answer is applied to a newer report of the same chat
trigger: Report message A, press Cancel while the box says Reporting, report message B in the same chat at once; the answer for A arrives.
effect: accept_message_report and fail_message_report match only the chat id, not the request or the stage: the box for B jumps to A's option list (or to Failed/Reported), and A's option ids are then sent with B's message ids.
fix: Give each flow a token (the RequestId of its current step) and apply an answer only when it equals the flow's token and the stage is the one waiting for it.

title: Report flow is session-wide but its open flag is per window
trigger: Open Report on a message in a chat window, then Report another message in the main window (or a second chat window) before closing the first.
effect: report_open is set in each window's own MessageUi but begin/report_messages overwrite the single session flow, so the first window's box now shows the second report's options/text and its Send reports the other messages; closing either calls clear_message_report and blanks the other box.
fix: Key the flow by window/asker (MessageReportFlow carries WindowKey) and let each window show only its own, or refuse a second open while one is live.

title: Rapid taps on a multiple-answer poll lose the first choice
trigger: In a poll that allows multiple answers tap option 1 then option 2 before the first setPollAnswer is applied by updatePoll.
effect: send_poll_answer builds the new set from the poll's current is_chosen (poll_answer_for_tap), which has not changed yet, so the second request sends only option 2 and replaces the first; the UI shows no pending state. A quiz can also get a second answer sent.
fix: Keep a per-poll vote stage (Idle | Sending{chosen, request}) in the session and build the next set from the pending chosen set; ignore taps while a quiz answer is in flight.

title: A held history press that never sees its mouse-up keeps a 15 ms poll loop and a stale drag alive
trigger: Press and hold on a history row, then lock with the hotkey (or switch chat by keyboard) and release. The MouseUp listener (history_message_list.rs:608) is registered only while the history list paints, so a locked or repainted-elsewhere window never delivers it.
effect: selection_drag stays Some, so the loop in selection_drag.rs:352 wakes every 15 ms for as long as it stays set (also under the lock). After a chat switch the next release applies the old drag to drag.chat, building the selection from loaded_selectable_ids(old chat). After unlock, a button-down move continues the old drag.
fix: Own the drag in a ChatUi value that sync_chat_ui replaces, clear it in close_for_lock, and end it on a MouseMove with no button pressed.

title: Closing a location request box leaves its lookup running
trigger: In a bot chat press a request-location keyboard button, then Cancel the box (request_share.rs:295/309/464 set request_share = None).
effect: request_locate (the lookup Task) is only ever overwritten (request_share.rs:125), never dropped on close, so the device location lookup the user cancelled runs to the end and writes its outcome into whatever request_share is open next.
fix: Put the lookup Task inside RequestShare as enum Locate { Searching(Task<()>), Found(..), Failed(..) } so closing the box drops it.

title: A typed inline reply is taken from the store and lost when it cannot be sent
trigger: Type a reply in an OS notification, then Quill is locked (or the chat refuses the send: no rights, closed topic).
effect: send_typed_notification_reply removes the text first; plan_inline_reply returns None when locked and send_text_snapshot can return Err, so the function returns false, the chat is opened instead and the typed text is gone.
fix: Take the text only after the send is accepted, or put it into the opened chat's composer draft.

title: One-shot session outcomes are drained by whichever screen is on screen later
trigger: Start a payment needing 3-D Secure, a Copy Message Link or a forward on account A, switch to B before the answer, switch back to A.
effect: The answer landed in A's background session. poll_drains takes verification_url, message_link_result, last_forward and the error Options on the next pass of the new screen: a bank page opens, the clipboard is overwritten or an old error note appears minutes later. put_on_screen forgets only communities outcomes.
fix: Tag each outcome with the ScreenEpoch/ask that made it (as CommunityOutcome) and drop untagged or older ones in put_on_screen; or hold them in OnScreen so the drop is free.

title: begin_jump enters Jumping before the jump can start or finish; several paths leave the machine in Jumping with no exit
trigger: Pull and release on a ready channel/topic pull when (a) pull.window is None, (b) select_topic_ui(next) does not change the topic, or (c) select_chat_request returns true but the chat does not change; machine.jumping() stays true
effect: The next-channel indicator stays at full height with the photo and the history stays lifted; handle() returns early while jumping so no new pull can start in this chat or topic until the user changes chat/topic
fix: Make Jumping carry the awaited ChatId/topic and a deadline; the frame clears it when the target is shown, when it times out, or when the jump task ends without opening it (task completion calls reset).

title: pull_jump_when_ready continuation opens the next chat without asking the lock gate
trigger: Pull and release to jump to the next unread channel, then lock Quill within the 1.5 s wait
effect: select_chat_request runs under the passcode lock: the next channel's chat is selected (and read marking/draft flush runs) behind the lock screen, and shows after unlock; the jump task polls driver state while locked
fix: Check refused_while_locked at the start of the continuation (drop the jump and reset the machine) per lock-is-a-render-state.

title: Save as HTML with 'Ask where to save' clears whatever selection/forward exists after the picker, and a second click opens a second picker
trigger: Select one rich message, click Save as HTML (folder picker opens), change the selection or start a forward, then pick a folder; or click Save as HTML twice
effect: clear_forward drops an unrelated selection/forward draft; two pickers lead to two exports of the same message; the export uses the captured chat/message, not the current selection
fix: Make the picker a stage (ForwardStage::SavingHtml{chat,msg}) and apply the answer only if the stage is still that one.

title: The send-as menu shows a spinner whenever the sender list is empty, loaded or not
trigger: Open the send-as menu when get_chat_available_message_senders fails or returns nothing
effect: Spinner forever; no error or close
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableMessageSender>> so failed shows an error row.

title: Tray read state lives in the per-window SendBoxUi but trays are account-wide, so another window can start, miss or forget a tray's reads
trigger: A chat window and the main window are open on the same account; the main window's chat has a tray whose photo/video read is still running. Send or attach in the chat window: check_tray_videos/check_tray_media loop over every tray of the account and record jobs in the chat window's send_box. Or send from a chat window whose preparation finishes after it closed: forget_tray_checks clears self.screen.composer_ui.send_box (whatever window is in place), not the window that read the file.
effect: The other window's tray_videos_checking / tray_media_checks_pending / tray_thumbnails_pending see no job for those paths, so its Send can go before the read ends (a soundless video not turned into a GIF, a HEIC not converted). Reads are also duplicated. media_checked/sound_checked entries remain in the window that did not forget them, so the same file attached again later reuses a stale answer (an old temp JPEG path).
fix: Key the read stages by tray (SendSlot) and keep them in ComposerSends next to the attachments they describe, not in the window's ComposerUi.

title: A background account's failed file preparation or missing client toasts an error on the account on screen
trigger: Account A: attach a large photo and tap Send (files are being prepared). Switch to account B before preparation finishes, with ffmpeg failing or timing out for the photo (or A's client gone).
effect: B's screen shows an error note ('could not send' / the prepare error) that belongs to A's send; A's draft and tray stay. deliver_live_send guards its success/failure notes with on_screen, but finish_media_prep's Err arm (line 302) and deliver_live_send's missing-client arm (line 324) set the note unconditionally.
fix: Route the note through the origin account: set it only when origin.slot.account is the screen's account (the on_screen test already in deliver_live_send), else drop it or queue it for that account.

title: upload_created_sticker drops the New Sticker box as if uploaded when the send failed
trigger: Press Done on a New Sticker with the driver channel failing (or no longer owning the set: owned_set_name None gives InvalidRequest)
effect: An error toast shows but create is cleared, the box closes and the user's edited image and chosen emoji are lost; the editor PNG (create.path) is also never removed
fix: Clear create only on Ok; on Err stay in the Naming stage

title: Picking a not-downloaded still sticker to adapt never requests the file
trigger: In Adapt from a Sticker (or Add existing), choose a webp sticker whose file is not on disk (library set never opened)
effect: local_media_path is None, the off-thread job returns None, edit_pixels_for_set shows 'Could not load image' (the WEBM branch downloads, this one does not)
fix: Download the file and wait in the DownloadingStill stage like pending_video

title: Install/remove of the viewed set treats Ok(None) (request skipped as busy) as success
trigger: Open a set box, press Add/Remove Stickers while a ManageStickerSet or reorder request for that set is still pending (double click, or right after the manager box closed)
effect: manage_sticker_set returns Ok(None) without sending; the box closes and the toast says 'Sticker set added/removed' though nothing was sent. With Ok(Some) the same success note and close happen before TDLib answers, so a later failure leaves a wrong note
fix: Match Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err separately; keep the box in an 'Installing' stage (button disabled, as sticker_set_action does) until the answer, close on success only

title: Archive of the viewed set closes the box and notes 'archived' on Ok(None)
trigger: Press Archive Stickers while a request for the same set is pending
effect: Same as install: nothing sent, box closes and 'archived' note shown
fix: Same stage enum for the set action; answer-driven close

title: Manager box closes and clears its edits as if saved; later commit steps fail silently
trigger: Mark sets removed and drag a new order, close the box; the removal succeeds but the reorder step fails, or the connection is down
effect: finish_manager clears the edits first; commit errors after the first step are discarded by pump_sticker_manager (let _) and commits.clear() drops the rest, so removals/order are lost with no note after the first step
fix: Keep edits until the commit queue reports done, or report the failing step with a toast and reopen offer

title: Thread start is adopted by whichever window renders first
trigger: Open a comment/reply thread from a chat window while the main window is also drawing (or the reverse).
effect: session.threads.thread is one session-wide slot but advance_thread runs from per_window_upkeep in every window and only branches on windows.scope.is_some(); the main window can take a chat window's thread (select_chat_with in the main window) and the chat window can close a thread the main window opened. restore_open_draft(window) then restores the thread draft into whichever composer rendered first.
fix: Record the asking window in the thread slot (owner key) and only that window's upkeep starts it.

title: One-slot offer cache thrashes when two windows show different chats
trigger: Main window shows chat A with a translate bar, a chat window shows chat B; both redraw (typing, new messages, animations).
effect: TranslateScreen::offer holds a single (OfferKey, language) keyed by chat; each window's translate_bar_model/translate_offer overwrites it, so every render re-walks the whole loaded history and runs offer_language on all texts. The key also lacks the `automatic` input (chat_auto_translate), so a toggle of automatic translation without a message change keeps a stale answer.
fix: Key the cache by chat (HashMap<ChatId, ..>) and include `automatic`; drop entries for chats no window shows (as pump does).

title: A failed selection translation leaves the box on the loading placeholder
trigger: Select text, Translate Selected Text, with the send failing (translate_selection returns Err), or change the language after an earlier job.
effect: request_dialog_translation takes the old job (dropped) and on Err leaves dialog.job = None; dialog_translation then returns None, which the body draws as the grey 'pending' lines, while only a status note says it failed. The box never shows the error text.
fix: Put the job into the dialog stage as Requested(Result<job, error>) and draw Failed for an Err instead of treating no translation as pending.

title: Message widgets in a locked, minimized or tray-hidden window stay 'visible': their runtimes keep running and their public data keeps being polled
trigger: Open a chat with a bot widget that watches its public data (RuntimeEvent::Watch(true)) in a chat window; press Lock (or minimize the main window showing it, or hide it to the tray). Leave it for minutes.
effect: WidgetEntry::visible is cleared only by a drawn history pass (reconcile_widgets), by the main window's next drawn frame without a conversation, or by closing a chat window. A locked chat window runs no upkeep (render_locked) and a hidden window draws no frame, so the widgets stay visible: their QuickJS runtimes keep running timers on their threads, schedule_widget_polls keeps sending getWidgetPublicData every period and background queries still go to the bot while Quill is locked or nobody can see them.
fix: Make a widget's on-screen state follow the window's own state (a per-window `Shown { window, view } | Hidden { since }` set from the lock, occlusion and hide events): close_for_lock and the window hide call widgets_left_window, and polls start only for widgets shown in an unlocked, visible window.

title: A hidden widget whose runtime still wants frames notifies its view on every landing, and is not ticked again when it comes back
trigger: Open an animated widget (CSS animation / requestAnimationFrame) in a chat window and scroll it off screen; keep another animated widget visible in the main window. Then scroll the first one back into view.
effect: hide_widgets sets entry.wants_frames = false but the runtime's Outbox::wants_frames stays true (a hidden runtime is never ticked, so its frame request stays). land_widgets compares the masked entry value with the runtime's, so every landing (60 per second from the other widget) marks the hidden entry changed and notifies the chat window's history view: that window redraws at the animation rate while showing nothing that moves. When the widget comes back, reconcile_widgets does not restore wants_frames, so it is not ticked until its own runtime happens to poke again.
fix: Keep the runtime's wish as its own field (`runtime_wants_frames`) and derive tick eligibility as `visible && runtime_wants_frames` where widgets_frame_start reads it; compare only the runtime value in land_widgets.

title: A failed widget storage write is not retried: `unsaved` is cleared before the write
trigger: Use a widget that writes localStorage while the disk is full or the widget folder is not writable; free the space; quit Quill (or let the widget be pruned).
effect: save_widget_storage takes `unsaved` with mem::take before storage::save; on error it only logs. The entry is clean, so the farewell, the debounce timer and prune_hidden_widgets never write it again; the widget's local storage is lost at the next start unless it changes again.
fix: Clear `unsaved` only after storage::save succeeds (or keep a `Storage { Clean | Dirty | Failed }` value per entry and retry on the next timer).
